axes_source: Read from data/brands/clickhouse.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #FAFF69 and the canvas #0A0A0A; contrast from the ink #FFFFFF on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #FAFF69; density from its 4px spacing base; geometry from its radii 4, 6, 8, 12px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion at 0.5 since its motion signature states no duration; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
brand_rule: The primary #FAFF69 reaches 18.45:1 on the canvas #0A0A0A, at least the 3:1 a control needs, so it carries the action.
